security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from markdown bash fences, inline paths, and generic anti-pattern headings. The three Python scripts contain user-controlled output file writes that can overwrite arbitrary local files if unsafe paths are supplied. No prompt injection, network access, or credential exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Constrain --output to a reports directory, refuse existing files by default, or require an explicit --force flag before overwriting.

remediation.issue: Executable setup and deployment examples in documentation
remediation.suggestion: Label commands as examples, separate deployment commands from quick start steps, and ask users to review each command before execution.

content.value_statement: Teams need clear architecture decisions before they build complex products. This skill provides structured guidance, reference notes, and lightweight scripts for architecture planning.
actual_capabilities: Guides architecture planning across frontend, backend, mobile, database, cloud, and DevOps technology areas.
Provides reference notes for architecture patterns, system design workflows, and technology decisions.
Includes Python CLI scripts that validate a target path and emit simple status reports.
Exports script results as JSON when users pass the --json and --output options.
Summarizes best practices for code quality, performance, security, and maintainability.
limitations: The bundled scripts are scaffolds and do not perform deep code analysis.
Commands in the guide require local dependencies and user review before execution.
Architecture recommendations are generic and must be adapted to project constraints.
The skill does not verify cloud configuration or approve production deployments.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Product Architecture
use_cases.description: Define components, data flow, integration boundaries, and major trade-offs before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Review an Existing Codebase Structure
use_cases.description: Use the project review workflow to identify architecture concerns, missing documentation, and follow-up checks.

use_cases.title: Compare Technology Stack Options
use_cases.description: Evaluate frontend, backend, database, mobile, and cloud choices against team skills and product constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Map a Simple Architecture
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a small web product.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this senior architect skill to outline a web app with React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Include components, data flow, and key risks.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Stack Options
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate decision support for a product team.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the tech decision guide to compare Next.js, Express, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and Supabase for my product. Explain trade-offs and give a recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Review Project Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of an existing repository.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this repository path with the project architect workflow. Summarize architecture strengths, weaknesses, and follow-up checks before any file changes.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Architecture Decisions
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced architecture governance for a growing system.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the architecture patterns and system design workflow to draft ADRs for scalability, integration, deployment, security, and observability. Include assumptions and rejected options.

output_examples.input: Design architecture for a B2B SaaS dashboard.
output: A component map covering frontend, API, data, authentication, and deployment boundaries.
A risk list for scaling, permissions, data privacy, and operational monitoring.
Suggested architecture decisions with alternatives and trade-offs.

output_examples.input: Compare Supabase with a custom Node.js backend.
output_examples.output: A trade-off summary covering delivery speed, control, data model needs, authentication, operations, and long-term maintainability.

output_examples.input: Run a basic project architecture review.
output_examples.output: A simple status report that confirms the target path, reports completion status, and provides a place for findings.

best_practices: Provide product goals, traffic expectations, compliance needs, and team skills before asking for architecture advice.
Review script commands before execution, especially options that write files or deploy resources.
Record major recommendations as architecture decisions with alternatives and trade-offs.
anti_patterns: Running setup or deployment commands from the guide without checking the current project.
Treating generic stack guidance as a final production architecture.
Using the placeholder scripts as evidence of a full security or dependency audit.

faq.question: Does this skill support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents commands and includes Python scripts, but command execution requires user action.

faq.question: What do the bundled scripts currently do?
faq.answer: They validate a target path, create a simple status report, and optionally export JSON output.

faq.question: Can it generate complete architecture diagrams?
faq.answer: It provides a diagram generator scaffold and planning guidance. The bundled script does not yet produce full diagrams.

faq.question: Is it enough for production architecture approval?
faq.answer: No. Use it for planning support, then validate decisions with engineers, security reviewers, and operations teams.

faq.question: Does it access secrets or environment variables?
faq.answer: No code reads secrets. The guide only shows a local setup example that copies .env.example to .env.
